I’m currently in my second year of a Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, specializing in Artificial Intelligence, at the International Islamic University Malaysia (IIUM).

Before that, I completed my Centre for Foundation Studies (CFS) at the IIUM Gambang campus with a CGPA of 3.92. I began my academic journey at Maahad Integrasi Tahfiz Sains Alam Impian (MITSAI), where I graduated with 8As in my SPM.
